title: Moab Giants

services.name: 5D Prehistoric Aquarium
services.desc: Bring the whole family for a day of discovery, adventure, and unforgettable memories in Utah’s dinosaur country. 💚 Not all our Giants are on land, this virtual “walking theater” brings to life some of the most unique deep sea creatures you’ll ever come face to face with. From the friendly sea-turtles to an intense encounter with a Megalodon, this adrenaline rush is one you won’t want to miss! Explore! Learn! Create Memories! Moab Giants is a unique experience of the ages for ALL ages! You’ll get as close as you ever imagined to life-size dinosaurs, both on land and under the sea, with plenty of photo ops to prove it! Start planning your Moab Giants adventure here! 📅 Opening Hours Monday:
